selected_problem: Fresh canonical-main inspection found that the checked-in RCL Authority Receipt v0.1 contract restricts action, approvalMode, requestId, workspace and metadata shapes, while RclAuthorityGate._record persisted whatever decide() assembled. Invalid action/mode or malformed envelope values could therefore create durable receipts that the repository's own published schema says are impossible.（最新规范主仓检查发现仓库内 RCL Authority Receipt v0.1 契约已经限制 action、approvalMode、requestId、workspace 与 metadata 的形状，但 RclAuthorityGate._record 会直接持久化 decide() 组装出的对象；未知动作/模式或畸形包络值因此可能生成与仓库公开 schema 自相矛盾的持久化回执。）

decision_provenance.route_basis: This is a direct contract/runtime parity defect at a single durable write boundary. The published receipt schema already supplies the invariant, so closing it requires neither a new authority model nor a forced mode rotation.（这是单一持久化写入边界上的直接契约/运行时一致性缺陷；公开回执 schema 已经给出不变量，因此无需选择新的授权模型或强制轮换模式。）
